description: Control-loop operations, their phases, and which phase fails.

options.content:
**Every trace here is one fleet operation.** A Client opens a span for installing a package, applying a configuration — a Managed Process's, and its own Supervisor set — applying offered connection settings, and updating itself (ADR-0016). Its phases are the child spans, and the outcome it reported to the Server is the span status, so *which phase failed* is a question these panels answer.

Message handling is deliberately not traced, so the rate below is operations and not traffic. A self-update spans a restart and still arrives as one trace.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       service_name AS service,
       COUNT(*) / ($__interval_ms / 1000) AS spans_per_second
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`, service
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       service_name AS service,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / ($__interval_ms / 1000) AS errored_per_second
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`, service
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration, 0.50) / 1000 AS p50_ms,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS p95_ms,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration, 0.99) / 1000 AS p99_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id = '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`
ORDER BY `time`

panels.title: Phases, by how often they fail

targets.rawSql:
SELECT span_name AS `Phase`,
       COUNT(*) AS `Runs`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Failed`,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS `Failed %`,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS `p95 ms`
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id != '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY span_name
ORDER BY `Failed` DESC, `Runs` DESC

panels.description: Child spans grouped by name. Where Tempo's service map showed which service talks to which, an Agent's spans are phases of one operation — so what is worth seeing is which phase fails.

panels.title: Operations

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trace_id AS `Trace`,
       span_name AS `Operation`,
       timestamp AS `Started`,
       duration / 1000 AS `Duration (ms)`,
       CASE status_code WHEN 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 'Error' WHEN 'STATUS_CODE_OK' THEN 'Ok' ELSE 'Unset' END AS `Outcome`,
       status_message AS `Message`
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id = '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND span_name REGEXP '${operation:regex}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.description: Root spans. Click a trace id to open it below.

panels.title: Trace detail

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trace_id AS traceID,
       span_id AS spanID,
       parent_span_id AS parentSpanID,
       service_name AS serviceName,
       span_name AS operationName,
       CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(timestamp) * 1000 AS DOUBLE) AS startTime,
       CAST(duration AS DOUBLE) / 1000 AS duration,
       CAST(span_attributes AS STRING) AS tags,
       CAST(resource_attributes AS STRING) AS serviceTags,
       CASE WHEN status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS statusCode
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE trace_id = '${trace}'
ORDER BY startTime ASC, duration DESC

panels.description: Set by clicking a trace id above, or paste one into the Trace variable.
